title: Robust Transfer Learning for Paper ECG Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.39581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Paper ECG recognition is challenging because real-world ECG images vary in layout, physical artifacts, and label availability. We introduce RobECG-CL, a rank-aware contrastive learning framework for robust paper ECG representation learning. Starting from standard 12-lead ECG recordings, we construct progressively degraded paper ECG views with heterogeneous layouts and train the model to balance same-recording invariance with degradation-aware ordering. Across synthetic stress tests on CODE-II and EchoNext, RobECG-CL improves robustness under severe degradation and few-shot transfer, outperforming contrastive learning baselines and surpassing the waveform-based foundation model, ECG-FM, in the 1% labeled setting. On 312 samples of hospital data with 37 labels, RobECG-CL achieves the best macro AUROC.

translated_title: 面向纸质心电图识别的鲁棒迁移学习
translated_abstract: 纸质心电图（ECG）识别具有挑战性，因为真实世界中的心电图图像在版式布局、物理伪影和标签可用性方面各不相同。我们提出了RobECG-CL，一个用于鲁棒纸质心电图表示学习的排序感知对比学习框架。从标准12导联心电图记录出发，我们构建了具有异构布局的渐进式退化纸质心电图视图，并训练模型在保持同一记录不变性的同时平衡退化感知的排序。在CODE-II和EchoNext数据集的合成压力测试中，RobECG-CL在严重退化和少样本迁移条件下提升了鲁棒性，优于对比学习基线，并在1%标注设置下超越了基于波形的基础模型ECG-FM。在包含37个标签的312个医院数据样本上，RobECG-CL取得了最佳的宏平均AUROC。
tldr: RobECG-CL是一种排序感知的对比学习框架，通过渐进退化和异构布局视图训练，显著提升纸质心电图识别在严重退化与少样本场景下的鲁棒性，并在仅1%标注数据时超越波形基础模型ECG-FM。
en_tdlr: RobECG-CL is a rank-aware contrastive learning framework that improves robustness under severe degradation and few-shot transfer for paper ECG recognition, outperforming contrastive baselines and surpassing the waveform-based foundation model ECG-FM in the 1% labeled setting.
